messages:
anja: starting the router change window now (03:00 UTC). plan is conservative: 30% -> 60% -> 100% with probes at each step. target model tag: v3-router-ops
ben: copy. what are concrete rollback triggers?
anja: quick list: p95 > 250ms sustained 5m, error rate (5xx) > 0.5% sustained 2m, or request queueing > 5s. also any cache regression observed in perf tests.
ben: pls put that in the deploy notes so PMs can see it.
deploy-bot: CI ✅ all checks passed. initiating weighted route change: green=70, blue=30 (v3-router-ops -> blue). will report step completion.
maya: question on session affinity — are we preserving cookies? will failing affinity cause user duplication?
leo: yes, cookie pin stays. config: session-cookie:router_pin; sticky TTL=1h. blue supports same hash.
sre-oncall: baseline p95=180ms, error rate=0.12%. keeping an eye.
deploy-bot: step 1 applied: 30% to blue. probe window: 5m.
anja: monitoring hooks: grafana link in release notes, automated slack alerts for p95 and 5xx. fallback route prepared: `route set blue=0 green=100`
ben: add canary logs collection toggled on (`EDGE_CANARY_LOG=1`) so we can diff requests quickly.
leo: adding pin for /api/checkout to hold on green if we see any payment-related errors.
sre-oncall: 2m in: seeing error spike to 0.8% 5xx concentrated on /v1/embed. stack traces show timeout to upstream cache.
maya: weird, embed service didn't get updated. is blue hitting a different pool?
aleph: (automated note) — embed-service-deploy at 02:50 succeeded in canary, not rolled to all.
ben: ok that mismatch explains it. we should fallback while we reconcile.
anja: agreed. initiating immediate fallback. moving traffic back to green. tagging incident note for postmortem.
deploy-bot: executing rollback: set weights blue=0 green=100. change applied. verifying...
sre-oncall: after rollback p95 back to 175ms, 5xx down to 0.13%. good.
anja: thanks team. follow-ups: 1) coordinate embed-service full rollout before we try blue again 2) update release notes to mention affinity + dependency 3) schedule a short preflight next time to validate backend parity.
ben: will draft the notes, pinging infra to coordinate embed roll.
maya: will also add a short checklist item: "verify all downstream services at expected revision" to release playbook.
leo: leave the canary logs on for 30m for diffs.
anja: closing the window early. we'll reconvene in slack when embed is rolled. :thumbsup: 
deploy-bot: thread closed by anja at 03:12 UTC (action: rollback complete).
